text:
maya: Quick sync: we have a short maintenance window tomorrow 01:00 UTC to roll a small runtime config update and restart a subset of dedicated pools. Expect short per-pool interruptions (seconds to a few minutes). Need: 1-line public statuspage, an impacted-customer email, and an ops FAQ with pin instructions. Who can draft now?
deploy-bot: schedule=2026-07-20T01:00:00Z; canary=12m; rollout=45m; auto-rollback=error_rate>5%_for_5m; notify=#eng-platform.
ops_ted: I'll own pins and runbook. I'll collect customers that should be pinned (p50<80ms). Will post list by 18:30 UTC.
support_amy: I'll draft messaging. Posting quick drafts below for review.
support_amy: STATUSPAGE (short): "Maintenance: rolling runtime update for dedicated inference pools in select regions. You may see brief interruptions to requests during pool restarts. No customer data will be affected. Window: 01:00UTC - 02:00 UTC."
support_amy: EMAIL (impacted customers): "Subject: Redwood maintenance: runtime update at 01:00 UTC

Hello,

We're applying a routine runtime configuration update and restarting a subset of dedicated inference pools tomorrow at 01:00 UTC. Impact: you may observe brief request interruptions or retries while affected pools restart. If your account is on our critical SLA list we will pin your workloads to the prior runtime snapshot for the duration.

We will monitor closely and automatically rollback if error signals cross the safety thresholds. We will post live updates to the status page and notify directly if we pause or rollback. No action needed unless this time conflicts with a maintenance freeze on your side; reply to coordinate.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops"
prod_liam: Can we add: "If generation quality is impacted we will hold the rollout and notify immediately" to the email? That helps reassure customers.
support_amy: added.
ops_ted: PIN COMMAND (ops-internal example):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/pins" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"cust-102","route":"/v1/complete","model":"rwd-13b-q","version":"2026-07-01"}'
```
ops_ted: I'll schedule the pinning 20 minutes before the window and hand over the list to support_amy.
support_amy: I'll queue the short statuspage publish 30 minutes before the window and the email at T+8 minutes into canary. I'll include localized time conversions and support alias.
maya: thanks all. Post-rollout: export token-level cost delta and any quality diffs for product. Keep edits to this thread only; deploy-bot should post schedule changes here automatically.
